annotations.title: Spain crypto tax calculator (FIFO, swaps, Modelo 721)

description: Spanish tax on crypto gains for one year, common regime (not Basque Country or Navarre). Takes a list of trades (buy, sell, swap) with their EUR values and fees, applies FIFO per crypto across all wallets (DGT criterion), treats crypto-to-crypto swaps as disposals at market value, adds fees to cost and deducts them from proceeds, and applies that year's savings scale (2025 and 2026: 19% to EUR 6,000, 21% to 50,000, 23% to 200,000, 27% to 300,000, 30% above), assuming no other savings income. Returns every disposal with its FIFO cost and gain, totals by asset, tax by band, holdings at year end, warnings, and an optional Modelo 721 check (over EUR 50,000 with providers abroad at 31 Dec; re-file if up by more than EUR 20,000). Estimate, not tax advice; staking, airdrops and the two-month rule are not covered. Source: https://borbur.net/tools/spain-crypto-tax-calculator/

csv.description: Alternative to trades: CSV text with header date,type,asset,amount,eur,fee,toAsset,toAmount (Spanish headers and ; also accepted). In a URL, separate lines with |

foreign_balance_eur.description: Optional: EUR value of crypto held with providers outside Spain on 31 Dec of that year (for the Modelo 721 check)

last_721_eur.description: Optional: value declared in your last Modelo 721

trades.description: Trades: objects {date:'YYYY-MM-DD', type:'buy'|'sell'|'swap', asset, amount, eur (total EUR market value, excluding fee), fee (EUR), toAsset and toAmount (swaps only)}

year.description: Tax year. Default: the latest year with a sale or swap
